blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Monday passed on final reading a bill institutionalizing a long-term infrastructure strategy to provide consistency in public works planning. The chamber overwhelmingly approved House Bill No. 11597, or the Masterplan for Infrastructure and National Development (MIND) Act, after 284 lawmakers voted in favor and eight against. One abstained. The measure directs the government to craft a comprehensive 30-year infrastructure plan, updated every six years, as a long-term roadmap for public works free from shifting political winds.
